item.title: From Hendrix to Bowie: the trippiest music concert posters – in pictures
item.description: Günther Kieser is behind some of the most singular music poster designs of the 20th century. The exhibition Sculpting Sound: Günther Kieser’s Music Posters at New York’s Poster House gallery showcases his decades-spanning work and runs from 12 November to 11 April 2027. item.title: Stay sharp, get used to loss – and pay your taxes: the wit and wisdom of Willie Nelson
item.description: An exclusive extract from his memoir • Read an interview with Willie Nelson here Longevity is a blessing and also a burden.
